tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gcod dbang nam mkha' sgo 'byed du grags pa zhes bya ba'i

dbu phyogs legs par bzhugs pa lags/ na mo gu ru/ gcod yul gyi dbang nam mkha' sgo 'byed du grags pa bskur bar 'dod pas/ maṇḍal padma 'dab bzhi tshom bu phyogs mdog can de'i steng du mañdzi la gtor ma dkar zlum lnga tshom/ mar dang sha dang bu ram gyis brgyan pa bzhag /mtha' mchod gtor gang 'dzoms kyis bskor/ bgegs gtor spyi dang mthun par btang la bgegs bskrad/ phyogs skyong dang gzhi bdag la sngon 'gro gtor ma'i cho ga gang yang rung ba zhig gis gtor ma btang*/ mchod pa byin brlabs kyang spyi dang mthun/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i mdo bsgrub gang nus byas ste/ sngon 'gro'o/ /de'i sdom ni/ yo byad cha rkyen legs 'dzoms nas/ /legs bsham bgegs bskrad gtor ma btang*/ /mchod pa byin brlabs skyabs 'gro dang*/ /sems bskyed mdo bsgrub spyi 'gro yin/ /de nas bdag dang mdun bskyed gnyis ka swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis chos 'byung gi nang dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal yas kyi dbus su/ sna tshogs padma 'dab ma bzhi pa/ oṃ buddha ḍā ki nī oṃ/ dbus su sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo 'khor lo'i thor tshugs can/ oṃ badzra ḍā ki nī hūṃ/ shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon po'am rdo rje'i thor tshugs can/ oṃ ratna ḍā ki nī traṃ/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser po'am rin po che'i thor tshugs can/ oṃ padma ḍā ki nī hrīḥ nub tu padma mkha' 'gro ma dmar po'am padma'i thor tshugs can/ oṃ karma ḍā ki nī āḥ byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang khu rdo rje rgya gram gyi thor tshugs can/ thams cad kyang spyan gsum pa ḍā ma ru dang thod pa kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams pa/ zhabs gar stabs bsgyur ba/ rin po che dang rus pa la sogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rang mtshungs kyi 'khor 'bum sde dang bcas pa'o/ /hrīḥmahā ḍā ki niḥ

oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gtso mo'i mdun du rang nyid ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma gtso mo dang 'dra ba las/ phyag g.yon dril bu 'khrol ba'o/ / de nas bdug spos dang rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ hrī mos gus dag pa'i pho brang nas/ /bla ma dkon mchog gshegs su gsol/ /rang bzhin rnam dag gzhal yas nas/ /yi dam lha tshogs gshegs su gsol/ /rdo rje can gyi zhing khams nas/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro spyan 'dren no/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i zhing khams nas/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro spyan 'dren no/ /padma can gyi zhing khams nas/ /padma mkha' 'gro spyan 'dren no/ /'brug sgra sgrogs pa'i zhing khams nas/ /las kyi mkha' 'gro= 'khor lo can gyi zhing khams nas/ /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro= gar bzhugs gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /ma cig ye shes mkha' 'gro spyan 'dren no/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas mchog nas/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol/ /bstan pa rin chen gzhal yas nas/ /bstan srung chos skyong gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī a gu sha dzaḥ pa sha hūṃ/ spho ṭa baṃ/ ghaṇḍe hoḥ snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /dbang gi don du 'dir byon la/ /sna tshogs mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /ji ltar bltams pa nas/ shri ye hūṃ gis/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro la rnam snang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro la mi bskyod pa/ rin chen mkha' 'gro la rin chen 'byung*/ padma mkha' 'gro la snang mtha'/ las kyi mkha' 'gro la don grub/ rang nyid ma cig ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma la rigs lnga char gyis dbu brgyan/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro la/ /'bul lo bzhes shig byin gyis rlobs/ /oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī arghaṃ pra tītstsha āḥhūṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du rol mo nas shapta 'i bar du 'don pa spo/ oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī pañtsa a mṛ ta āḥhūṃ/

zhes nang mchod 'bul/ spro na/ bandha snod bzang yangs pa ru/ /rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag /rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman/ /rigs lnga'i dam tshig lnga yi dngos/ /ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas/ /dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /rgyu drug sems can kun sgrol shing*/ /bla ma yi dam tshogs la 'bul/ /mchod pa dam pa 'bul gyis bzhes/ /mchod bzhes dngos grub stsal du gsol/ / sngags rnying ma'i lugs dang mthun pa'i gyer byed par gda'/ gtor ma rnams yi dam gyi mngon rtogs gang rung zhig dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs par bya/ gtor ma dngos de bla ma yi dam dbyer med dam pa la yi dam gang byed kyi gtor tshogs kyis 'bul/ gnyis pa mkha' 'gro sde lnga la gong gi sngags thung re re'i mthar/ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gsum gyis 'bul/ gsum pa ste chos skyong la rang gi gtor chog gis 'bul/ bzhi pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang*/ lnga pa gzhi bdag gtor ma'i cho ga btang*/ drug pa a kā ro lan drug gis rigs drug la bsngo/ slob ma'i rgyud la nyams rtogs khyad par can skye bar gsol ba btab/ brgyud pa'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas slob ma la ji ltar bskul ba'i cho ga'i bya ba rnams rang gis kyang dmigs pa'i sgo nas bdag 'jug du blangs/ tshogs rdzas bshams pa rnams yi dam gang byed kyi gtor chog dang mthun par byin gyis rlabs te bzhag go /de dag gi sdom ni/ stong nyid lhar bskyed spyan 'dren dang*/ /dgug gzhug rgyas btab mchod gtor 'bul/ /gsol 'debs bdag 'jug tshogs byin rlabs/ /dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i spyi sdom yin/ /de nas slob ma rnams nang du gzhug /chab btang gral la 'khod/ me tog bkye bsdu bya/ sngon 'gro chos bshad byas la/ maṇḍal 'bul du gzhug ste/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ / thugs chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/

/'gro ba 'dren pa'i don slad du/ / rdo rje 'chang du sku sprul nas/ /dbang bskur zab mo stsol ba dang*/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo bla na med/ /shin tu rgya chen bskor du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum dang*/ dpon slob thams cad kyis sher snying lan gsum mam lan bdun bzlog pa dang bcas pa bya/ 'di'i sngon du bgegs gtor gtong ba'i lugs kyang 'dug pas spro na de bzhin du bya/ de nas skyabs 'gro 'bogs te 'dis rjes su zlos byar gzhug go / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog /zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su= tshogs rnams kyi mchog /byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog pa'i 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ / lan gsum/ sems bskyed ni/ dgongs su gsol gong bzhin/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ sa chen por bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang*/ dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyis te/ sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o/ /ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi'o/ /dbugs ma dbyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bgyi'o/ / lan gsum/ 'jug sems kyang len pa'i srol kyang yod mod/

logs su ma byas kyang chog /bsdus pa la mngon par dga' bas gur nas byung ba'i rgyun bshags sam/ sangs rgyas chos dang sogs kyi chog ste sngon 'gro'o/ /dngos gzhi la nam mkha' sgo 'byed dngos ni/ spros bral dngos med la brten pa'i ngo sprod pa dang*/ spros bcas dngos po la brten nas ngo sprod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ khyed rang rnams kyis lus gnad bcas/ rlung rang sar bzhag /sems bzo bcos med par lhan ne ba'i ngang nas cher re ltos shig /de'i ngo bo ni rang gzhan du ma grub de bzhin du kha dog dang dbyibs dang phyi dang nang dang bem po dang*/ shes pa 'gro ba dang go ba gang yang ngos bzung med par skye 'gags gnas gsum dang bral ba'i ngang de nyid la 'khor 'das thams cad 'char du rung ba 'di ka don dam shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa de yin no/ / zhes gnas pa'i steng nas ngo sprad/ yang khyed rang rnams dran pa legs par bzung la rnam rtog gi skye 'gags gnas gsum gyi steng du 'char sgo ji ltar 'dug pa lta dgos pa'i rnam rtog zhig bskyed la gzhig 'grel thongs shig /ces lta ru gzhug /yang 'di skad du/ sems gnas pa'i rnam rtog skyes pa'i tshe yang skye bzhin pa'i dus de nyid nas ngos bzung med/ rnam rtog shar nas ma 'gags par lam me yod pa'i skabs de nyid na/ phyi nang bar gsum/ mthong thos rig gsum gang gi ngo bor yang 'di lta bu'o zhes ma grub par gnas pa'i dus na yang ngo bzung med/ yang rnam rtog yal ba'i tshe yul 'di lta bu zhig tu tshul 'di lta bur 'gags zhes kyang dmigs su med/ des na skye 'gags gnas gsum du snang ba 'di thams cad 'char sgo ma 'gags tsam ma gtogs ngos bzung med pa 'di gsar du byung ba ma yin gdod nas gnas lugs lags so/ /de nas rang ngo ma shes na rnam rtog bdud yin/ rang ngo shes na chos nyid kyi rol pa zhes gsungs zhes sogs ngo sprod/ rgyas bsdus slob ma'i rgyud dang 'tsham par bshad/

de lta bu'i gnas lugs mi rtogs shing phung du 'jug mkhan bdag gces 'dzin 'di yin pas/ lus 'di la gces pa'i snyems khrig rdul tsam yang med par gnod byed 'byung po thams cad la blos rgyangs kyis thongs shig /yang lus sems gces par 'dzin pa'i phyir rnam rtog kho rang gi ngo bo la cher gyi ltos la/ phaṭaḥ ces brjod la de dbyings blta zhing*/ phaṭaḥ gnyis pa ni/ khyed rang rnams kyis mig mi rig dgu rig 'di rkang mthil gnyis su 'od dkar po bya sgong tsam gnyis su song*/ 'gril nas gsang gnas su cung zad 'dug / de bzhin du lte ba/ snying ga /mgrin pa/ spyi gtsug gi sgo rnams su 'gril/ spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga nas 'don la khad khad 'dug pa la/ phaṭaḥ ces brjod pa'i rgyangs kyi thon rnam smin gyi lus skyed rnams la zan du bor/ rig pa gsal la ngos bzung med pa de nam mkha' la chams te khyab pa'i ngang der lhod kyis zhog cig /phaṭaḥ dmigs pa 'di lan gsum 'bogs pa las/ dang po la slob ma rnams skyil krung mnyam bzhag byed/ gnyis pa la tsog pus 'phongs sa la ma reg tsam dang bcas/ lag pa snying khar rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya byed/ gsum pa langs te rkang pa'i brang sa la btsug / thal mo spyi bor sbyar/ gsum ka la nywa bzhi sgrengs zhing gyen du blta'o/ /rol mo'i mthar rol mo byed pa'i lugs kyang yod/ 'di skabs ye shes phebs pa'ang 'byung ngo*/ /de nas phyag rgya'i rjes gnang ni/ 'di ni mkha' 'gro thams cad kyis/ /pha rol phyin drug mtshon pa'i rgyan/ /rgyan de thogs la bdud rnams mchod/ /rgyan drug rus pa'i dbu mar ro/ /oṃ mahā ḍā ki nī ka ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes rgyan drug g.yogs/ gsung sngags kyi rjes gnang ni/ 'di ni mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi/ /gzung 'dzin dbyings su gcod pa'i sgra/ /sgra 'di sgrogs cing bdud rnams chod/ /gsung skad phaṭa kyi dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ mahā ḍā ki nī waka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/

dbyings rig bsre ba'i/ phaṭaḥ lan gsum brjod/ 'di ni mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi/ /don dam stong nyid snying po'i don/ /don 'di bsgom zhing bdud rnams chod/ /chos nyid don gyi dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ mahā ḍā ki nī tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ 'di ni mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi/ khams gsum dbang du bsdud pa'i sgra/ /sgra 'di sgrogs cing bdud rnams chod/ /cang te'u sgra yi dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ mahā ḍā ki nī gu ṇa abhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes cang te'u khrol du bcug / 'di ni mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi/ /snang srid bden med rtogs pa'i skad/ /skad 'dis bsgyur zhing bdud rnams chod/ /mi rkang gling bu'i dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ mahā ḍā ki nī karma abhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes rkang dung 'bud du bcug / 'dir mig dar me tog sbyin/ de nas byin rlabs lha yi ye shes 'bebs pa ni/ maṇḍal phul/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad nas byon te/ khyed rang rnams la thim pas/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas kyang mkha' 'gro sde lnga dpag tu med pa gar stabs ling ling byung ste/ rgya mtsho'i la char bab pa bzhin du khyed rang la sib sib thim/ de nas rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ gong gi lha bskyed pa'i sngags kyis/ a be sha ya a āḥ zhes btags pa mang du brjod/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/ zhes spyi bor rdo rje bzhag pa la me tog gtor zhing brtan par bya/ snying khar rdo rje bzhag la/ gnas gsum mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i tshogs/ khyed kyi snying la yang dag zhugs/ / rtag tu byin gyis brlabs par byed/ /tshul 'di gzhan la ma smra zhig / ces gsang bar gdams/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas la/ /rigs pa me tog 'di 'bul nas/ /rigs lnga mkha' 'gros rjes bzung nas/ /bdud tshogs dbyings su grol bar shog

/ ces me tog 'bul du gzhug / e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /ltos shig ltos shig 'di la ltos/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ khyed ni ye shes mkha' 'gro'i rigs/ /he badzra pā she / zhes blta bar bskul/ mdun bskyed ji ltar bskyed pa bzhin du slob ma la lha ngo bstan/ maṇḍal steng gi gtor ma lnga tsam ma cig ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dang mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i tshogs dang bcas pa gsol 'debs su bcug /las kyi rdo rjes lag tu bzung la/ dpon slob thams cad kyis gsol 'debs dbyangs dang bcas pa bya/ lag len la rgyal ba don 'grub kyis mdzad pa'i gsol 'debs dgongs skyod ma mdzad kyin 'dug /de rjes gtor dbang du spyi dang mthun par bskur la rol mo'i sgra bya/ de nas gtor ma las dngos grub kyi rdzas cung zad re slob ma rnams la thob byar 'jug /zan zhi ba/ mar rgyas pa/ bu ram dbang*/ sha nas mngon spyod grub bo zhes bya/ rjes khas len maṇḍal yon 'bul ba spyi dang dang 'dra/ de dag la sdom ni/ chos bshad maṇḍal gsol btab dang*/ /bgegs gtor mdo sgrub skyabs sems 'bogs/ /ngo sprod gnyis dang rjes gnang lnga/ /lha yi byin dbab rten gnas la/ /dam bzhag me tog gtor ba dang*/ /blta bar bskul nas lha ngo bstan/ /gsol 'debs gtor dbang dngos grub rnams/ /rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang mthun/ /zhes so/ /de nas tshogs phud 'bul ba nas brtsams/ lha'i gtor ma gtong ba'i bar du bya zhing*/ de rjes yig brgya bzod gsol gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu ba/ smon lam bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /tshogs gzhung sogs cho ga'i rgyan chog rnams la/ bla ma snga ma rnams kyis 'gros nag gi lugs bzhin mdzad pa ni/ de la yi dam mdzad pa'i bag chags btab pa tsam yin gyi/ gcig tu nges par dgos pa ma yin la/ phag mo bdag med ma la sogs pa rigs tshad ldan zhig gis cho ga gang la brten kyang chog de ltar gcod kyi chos dbang sems la bskur ba'i lag len 'di yang*/

lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nor ba'i skyon thams cad spangs te/ byin rlabs bla ma brgyud pa'i phyag len bzhin tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //de ltar gcod tshogs po ti brgya brgyad kyi/ /yang snying man ngag legs bshad rin chen

'phreng*/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i chos 'byor gyis 'bul ba/ /sel phyir grags pa dpal bzang ded dpon gyis/ /rdo rje 'chang dngos tā ra nā tha yis/ /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i nub gyur rab dgongs nas/ /kun la phan phyir lag len bca' bar bris/ /'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba rgya mtsho las/ /'gro kun kun mkhyen sangs rgyas myur thob shog /gcod yul nam mkha' sgo 'byed 'di nyid kyis/ khams gsum 'gro kun bdag gis smin byas nas/ /phan dang bde ba'i mkha' dbyings gang ba dang*/ /nges don bstan pa dar ba'i bkra shis shog /bkra shis/ / mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 346 -- PAGE 347 -- PAGE 343 -
